newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to cut T-bill rates by 10 bps from Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: Greece to cut T-bill rates by 10 bps from Aug 19.

text.p: Greece will cut its three-, six- and 12-month T-bill rates by a tenth of a point to 8.4, 8.7 and 9.5 percent respectively from August 19, the finance ministry said in a statement.
A public offering of 12-month T-bills will take place on August 20, it said.
The ministry will also seek to raise 100 billion drachmas through an auction of FRNs on August 21.
Details of the auction will be made available later, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
